prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
competitors_mentioned: ACA Marketplace plans and subsidy eligibility
answer_verbatim:
**My first call would be Apollo Health Insurance** in Lee’s Summit. It serves the Kansas City metro, works with individual and family plans—including ACA Marketplace coverage—and says it compares plans from multiple carriers at no cost to you. Call **816-400-4477** or visit [Apollo’s Kansas City broker page](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/).

A strong alternative is **BBS Insurance** in North Kansas City. It also handles Marketplace and private individual plans, and its site reports a **5.0 Google rating across 90 reviews**. Call **816-205-4664** or visit [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

There isn’t one universally “best” broker: the right plan depends on your estimated household income, doctors, prescriptions, and eligibility for Marketplace subsidies. When you call, ask them to compare **ACA Marketplace plans and subsidy eligibility**, confirm your doctors and medications are covered, and explain deductibles and out-of-pocket limits—not just the monthly premium. Broker services are generally free, but confirm any fees and which carriers they can quote.
